about: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Firis" is the 2nd instalment: after Firis encounters alchemy and is able to leave town, she is taken on a magical journey that has no limits.
summary: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs!
